nodes.name: As we move toward using AI tooling for code generation, it is reassuring to know that all our code is checked and scanned to provide a sanity check on the quantity of code being produced.

NEW: Sonar releases its 2027 State of Code Developer Survey Report
Code is abundant. Confidence is scarce.
Sonar provides independent, zero-trust verification and governance so you can confidently ship every change, at any volume, at agent speed.
Intent goals and standards, clearly specified
Intent: goals and standards, clearly specified
Agents often lack the context to work well in large, complex codebases. Without clear goals and standards, they guess.
Sonar Vortex gives agents codebase context and constraints before they write, so the change fits your design on the first attempt.
Everything you need to verify AI code
The most comprehensive and accurate zero trust code verification platform. Provides multi-layered review of all code, and findings that are consistent, explainable, repeatable, and auditable.
Precise, efficient software supply chain and dependency assessment (SCA) to raise your security posture, preventing agents from introducing third party vulnerabilities.
Verify every change before you merge
Inspects every PR, answers questions in context, and applies fixes to keep reviews moving. Automatically diagnoses CI failures and enforces review policies you write in plain language.
Gives AI coding agents the context and constraints they need when they write, verifies their output in real time, and provides immediate feedback when something needs fixing.
Clear your backlog and tech debt
Autonomously clears tech debt from your existing codebase by opening verified, ready-to-merge pull requests. Each fix is scanned and verified by Sonar's engine before you see it.
The AI security agent that hunts logic flaws
An AI-powered agent that runs a deep analysis of your SonarQube projects, hunting broken access control, business logic, and authentication flaws that traditional analysis was never built to catch.
